title: Document preconditions for OutboxStore::record_failure
description:
Location: crates/kith-store/src/outbox.rs, line 78

The record_failure() function lacks documentation of critical preconditions and side effects:
1. After 10 failures, the function marks the message failed AND deletes it from outbox
2. Callers need to know that subsequent calls for the same message_id will error
3. No explanation of why 10 attempts specifically, or total elapsed time before failure

Doc comment should clarify:
- The 10-attempt threshold and rationale (service-level decision)
- That the outbox entry is deleted after mark_failed (line 95)
- Caller should not retry after the function deletes the row
